examples.text: na yānagatassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na yānagatassa agilānassa dhammo desetabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca yānagatassa agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
yānaṃ nāma vayhaṃ ratho sakaṭaṃ sandamānikā. yānaṭṭhaṃ nāma bhaṇḍaṃ yāne nikkhittaṃ hoti.

53965.meaning1: wanting a vehicle; in need of a carriage
53965.meaning2: who wants a vehicle; who is looking for a carriage

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imāsaṃ pokkharaṇīnaṃ tīre evarūpaṃ dānaṃ paṭṭhapeyyaṃ, annaṃ ann'aṭṭhikassa, pānaṃ pān'aṭṭhikassa, vatthaṃ vatth'aṭṭhikassa, yānaṃ yān'aṭṭhikassa, sayanaṃ sayan'aṭṭhikassa, itthiṃ itthi'ṭṭhikassa, hiraññaṃ hiraññ'aṭṭhikassa, suvaṇṇaṃ suvaṇṇ'aṭṭhikassā'ti.

53966.meaning1: giving a cart; who gives a vehicle

examples.text: annado balado hoti, vatthado hoti vaṇṇado, yānado sukhado hoti, dīpado hoti cakkhudo.

53968.meaning1: use of vehicles; enjoyment of vehicles

examples.text: evarūpo vatthabhogo ahosi, sāṇaṃ dhāreti tipakkhavasanaṃ. evarūpo yānabhogo ahosi, jajjararathakena yāti paṇṇachattakena dhāriyamānenā'ti.

53971.meaning1: store of vehicles; accumulation of carriages; (comm) accumulation of sandals
53971.commentary: (DNa) yānasannidhimhi yānaṃ nāma vayhaṃ, ratho, sakaṭaṃ, sandamānikā, sivikā, pāṭaṅkī'ti, n'etaṃ pabbajitassa yānaṃ. upāhanā pana pabbajitassa yānaṃ'y'eva.

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, annasannidhiṃ pānasannidhiṃ vatthasannidhiṃ yānasannidhiṃ sayanasannidhiṃ gandhasannidhiṃ āmisasannidhiṃ iti vā iti evarūpā sannidhikāraparibhogā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo'ti, iti vā hi, bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.

53972.meaningLit: rule about (teaching the Dhamma to someone travelling in a) vehicle

53973.grammar: pron, nt nom & acc pl of ya

examples.text: yāni sotāni lokasmiṃ, sati tesaṃ nivāraṇaṃ, sotānaṃ saṃvaraṃ brūmi, paññāy'ete pidhiyyare.
yāni kho pan'assa honti sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni jimheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni, tāni yathābhūtaṃ āvikattā hoti satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu.
yān'imāni apatthāni, alābūn'eva sārade, kāpotakāni aṭṭhīni, tāni disvāna kā rati.

53975.meaning1: leading to; going to; conducive to
53975.commentary: (DNa) devayāniyo maggo'ti pāṭiyekko devalokagamanamaggo nāma n'atthi, iddhividhañāṇass'eva pan'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tena h'esa yāva brahmalokā'pi kāyena vasaṃ vattento devalokaṃ yāti. tasmā taṃ devayāniyo maggo'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: atha kho so, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu tathārūpaṃ samādhiṃ samāpajji, yathāsamāhite citte devayāniyo maggo pāturahosi.
mettāya, bhikkhave, cetovimuttiyā āsevitāya bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya ekādasānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā.

daḷhe khīle vā thambhe vā'ti kho, bhikkhave, kāyagatāya satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tasmā't'iha vo, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, kāyagatā no sati bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā'ti.
yān'īdha bhūtāni samāgatāni, bhummāni vā yāni va antalikkhe, sabb'eva bhūtā sumanā bhavantu, atho'pi sakkacca suṇantu bhāsitaṃ.
yān'īdha bhūtāni samāgatāni, bhummāni vā yāni va antalikkhe, tathāgataṃ devamanussapūjitaṃ, buddhaṃ namassāma suvatthi hotu.

53979.meaning1: (of the body) sustenance; preservation; continuance; upkeep; support (of)
53979.meaning2: sustenance, nourishment, keeping up of the body

examples.text: bhojane mattaññuno bhavissāma paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya

53980.meaning1: to sustain oneself; to keep going
53980.commentary: (THa) bahuṃ yāpan'atthaṃ abhuñjiṃsū'ti paṇītaṃ bahuṃ bhuñjantā'pi yāpanamattam'eva āhāraṃ bhuñjiṃsu. (VISMa) yāpan'atthan'ti sarīrassa yāpanāya.

examples.text: paṇītaṃ yadi vā lūkhaṃ, appaṃ vā yadi vā bahuṃ. yāpan'atthaṃ abhuñjiṃsu, agiddhā n'ādhimucchitā.

53982.grammar: nt, dat sg of yāpana, caus (+gen)
53982.meaning1: for sustenance; for preservation (of); for continuance

examples.text: n'eva davāya, na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya, vihiṃs'ūparatiyā brahmacariy'ānuggahāya

53983.meaning1: able to keep going; able to support oneself; sustainable
53983.meaningLit: to cause to be kept going

examples.text: kacci vo, anuruddhā, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci piṇḍakena na kilamathā'ti?
kacci te, āvuso channa, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamo'sānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamo'ti?

53984.commentary: (DNa) yāpayati ca vas'iddhibhāvanāyā'ti vasippatto hutvā iddhibhāvanāya yāpeti.

examples.text: bhavati yadi gihī ciraṃ yapeti, cirataraṃ pabbajati yadi tato hi, yāpayati ca vas'iddhibhāvanāya, iti dīgh'āyukatāya taṃ nimittan'ti.
atha kho bhagavā saccakaṃ nigaṇṭhaputtaṃ etadavoca, yā'pi kho te esā, aggivessana, purimā kāyabhāvanā bhāsitā sā'pi ariyassa vinaye no dhammikā kāyabhāvanā.

53986.meaning2: nourished, kept up, supported one's life

examples.text: y'āssa aparisuddhakāyasamācāratā na s'āssa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbā. yā'pi'ssa aparisuddhavacīsamācāratā na sā'pi'ssa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbā. yañ'ca kho so labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ, tam'ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbaṃ.

dhanañ'jāni, āvuso, brāhmaṇo rājānaṃ nissāya brāhmaṇagahapatike vilumpati, brāhmaṇagahapatike nissāya rājānaṃ vilumpati. yā'pi'ssa bhariyā saddhā saddhakulā ānītā sā'pi kālaṅ'katā, aññāssa bhariyā assaddhā assaddhakulā ānītā.

53988.meaning1: sustains oneself (with); nourishes oneself (with); continues to live (by)
53988.meaning2: nourishes, keeps up, supports one's life

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana sabbaso ajaddhukaṃ paṭijāneyyaṃ, imā ca me devatā dibbaṃ ojaṃ lomakūpehi ajjhohāreyyuṃ, tāya c'āhaṃ yāpeyyaṃ, taṃ mam'assa musā'ti.
atītaṃ n'ānusocanti, nappajappanti n'āgataṃ, paccuppannena yāpenti, tena vaṇṇo pasīdati.

53989.meaning1: keeps going (by); continues to go (with); stays on the road (by)
53989.meaning2: (of a vehicle) continues to go; stays on the road

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, jajjarasakaṭaṃ veṭhamissakena yāpeti, evam'eva kho, ānanda, veṭhamissakena maññe tathāgatassa kāyo yāpeti.
mā āyasmā channo satthaṃ āharesi. yāpet'āyasmā channo, yāpentaṃ mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ icchāma.

53991.meaning1: to sustain oneself (with); to support oneself (by); to keep oneself going

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, dubbhikkhaṃ hoti dussassaṃ dullabhapiṇḍaṃ, na sukaraṃ uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo asamayo padhānāya.

53992.meaning2: having nourished, having kept up, having supported one's life

53993.meaning2: nourishing, keeping up, supporting one's life

examples.text: mā āyasmā channo satthaṃ āharesi. yāpet'āyasmā channo, yāpentaṃ mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ icchāma.

53994.meaning1: sustained oneself (with); nourished oneself (with); continued to live (by)
53994.meaning2: nourished, kept up, supported one's life

examples.text: te tattha sākabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ… vanamūlaphal'āhārā yāpesuṃ pavattaphalabhojī.

53995.meaning1: watch (of the night); one sixth of the day; about four hours
53995.meaning2: watch of the night, 1/3 of a night
53995.commentary: (NIDD1a) purimaṃ yāman'ti rattiyā paṭhamakoṭṭhāsaṃ. majjhimaṃ yāman'ti rattiyā dutiyakoṭṭhāsaṃ. pacchimaṃ yāman'ti rattiyā tatiyakoṭṭhāsaṃ.

examples.text: ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa rattiyā pacchime yāme tatiyā vijjā adhigatā avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā tamo vihato āloko uppanno
rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhehi

53996.commentary: (DHPa) yāman'ti satthā attano dhamm'issaratāya desanākusalatāya ca idha tiṇṇaṃ vayānaṃ aññataraṃ vayaṃ yāman'ti.

examples.text: attānañ'ce piyaṃ jaññā, rakkheyya naṃ surakkhitaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ aññataraṃ yāmaṃ, paṭijaggeyya paṇḍito.
jegucchī nipako bhikkhu, cātuyāmasusaṃvuto, diṭṭhaṃ sutañ'ca ācikkhaṃ, na hi nūna kibbisī siyā'ti.

53998.meaning1: of the underworld; of the world of the dead

examples.text: tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā yāmā devā saddam'anussāvesuṃ, lābhā vata bho vajjīnaṃ, suladdhalābhā vajjipajāya, yattha tathāgato viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho
cātumahārājikānaṃ sahassaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahassaṃ yāmānaṃ sahassaṃ tusitānaṃ sahassaṃ nimmānaratīnaṃ sahassaṃ paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ sahassaṃ brahmalokānaṃ.
